title_sq: Ne Shkoze, Shitet Vile 2 Kate, Me Super Pamje !!
description_sq: Ne Kodrat e Shkozes, ne super pozicion, shitet nje vile dy kateshe. Vila shtrihet ne truall 281 m² me gjurme ndertimi rreth 111 m² per kat duke e bere siperfaqen e banimit 218 m² te pajisur me certifikate pronesie. Ne katin e pare organizohet ne hapesira mjaft te bollshme per ndenje bashke me ambjentin e gatimit me dalje ne ballkon, dy dhoma gjumi ku njera eshte me tualet, gjithashtu me dalje ne ballkon si dhe nje tualet tjeter. Te dy tualetet jane me dritare. Edhe kati i dyte ka te njejten planimetri dhe organizim, ambjentin e ndenjes bashke me ambjentin e gatimit, dy dhoma dhe dy tualete. Ne secilin kat ka balkone te bollshme. Duhet theksuar se investimi eshte bere para dy vitesh nga shitesi me cilesine maksimale duke filluar nga sistemi elektrik, sistemi hidraulik, sistemi i kondicionimit chiller e deri tek ndricimi led, pa haruar ketu dhe pajisjet elektroshtepiake, guzhinen dhe mobilimin te gjitha te cilesise me te mire ne treg. Vila pozicionohet ne nje vendodhje qe te jep mundesine te nje pamje te lire dhe te mrekullueshme 360 grade, ajrin e paster qe ofrojne kodrat e Shkozes si dhe qetesia, duke e bere nje eksperience mjaft te mire jetesen. Aksesohet shume lehte nga rruga kyesore. Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt.
title_en: In Shkoze, 2-storey villa for sale, with a great view!!
description_en: In the hills of Shkoza, in a great position, a two-story villa is for sale. The villa is located on a plot of 281 m² with construction traces of about 111 m² per floor, making the living area 218 m², equipped with ownership certificates. On the first floor, it is organized in quite spacious spaces for living together with the cooking area with access to the balcony, two bedrooms, one of which has a bathroom, also with access to the balcony and another toilet. Both toilets have windows. The second floor also has the same layout and organization, the living area together with the cooking area, two rooms and two toilets. There are spacious balconies on each floor. It should be noted that the investment was made two years ago by the seller with the highest quality, starting from the electrical system, the hydraulic system, the chiller air conditioning system and up to the LED lighting, not forgetting the electrical appliances, the kitchen and the furniture, all of the best quality in the market. The villa is positioned in a location that gives you the opportunity of a free and wonderful 360-degree view, the clean air offered by the hills of Shkoza, as well as the tranquility, making life a very good experience. It is very easily accessible from the main road. The property has proper documentation.
